import json, subprocess, pathlib, os, socket
out={"commands":[],"sandbox_startup":"NOT_RUN","allowed_write":"NOT_RUN","denied_write":"NOT_RUN","network_isolation":"NOT_RUN"}
def run(label,argv):
 try:
  r=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
  e={"label":label,"argv":argv,"exit_code":r.returncode,"stdout":r.stdout,"stderr":r.stderr}
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
  e={"label":label,"argv":argv,"exit_code":None,"timeout_seconds":20,"stdout":str(e.stdout or ""),"stderr":str(e.stderr or "")}
 out["commands"].append(e)
 return e["exit_code"]==0
def main():
 assert os.getuid()==1007
 assert not any(k in os.environ for k in ("OPENAI_API_KEY","DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"))
 out["credentials_present"]=False
 out["security_status"]=[s for s in pathlib.Path("/proc/self/status").read_text().splitlines() if s.startswith(("Cap","NoNewPrivs:","Seccomp"))]
 out["apparmor_profile"]=pathlib.Path("/proc/self/attr/current").read_text().strip()
 prefix=["codex","--profile","deepseek-v4-pro","sandbox","linux","--"]
 if not run("sandbox_startup",prefix+["/bin/true"]):
  out["sandbox_startup"]="FAIL";return
 out["sandbox_startup"]="PASS"
 if not run("allowed_write",prefix+["python","-c","from pathlib import Path; p=Path('/workspace/allowed-probe'); p.write_text('06p'); assert p.read_text()=='06p'"]):
  out["allowed_write"]="FAIL";return
 out["allowed_write"]="PASS"
 control=pathlib.Path("/outside/control");control.write_text("unchanged")
 out["outside_write_without_codex"]="PASS"
 denied="import pathlib,errno; p=pathlib.Path('/outside/control')\ntry:\n p.write_text('unexpected')\nexcept OSError as e:\n assert e.errno in (errno.EACCES,errno.EPERM,errno.EROFS); print('write denied',e.errno)\nelse:\n raise RuntimeError('outside write unexpectedly allowed')"
 if not run("denied_write",prefix+["python","-c",denied]):
  out["denied_write"]="FAIL";return
 assert control.read_text()=="unchanged"
 out["denied_write"]="PASS"
 with socket.socket() as server:
  server.bind(("127.0.0.1",0));server.listen(4);port=server.getsockname()[1]
  with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",port),timeout=2): pass
  conn,_=server.accept();conn.close()
  out["loopback_control_without_codex"]="PASS"
  code=f"import socket\ntry:\n s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',{port}),timeout=2)\nexcept OSError as e:\n print('connection denied or isolated',repr(e))\nelse:\n s.close(); raise RuntimeError('outer loopback unexpectedly reachable')"
  out["network_isolation"]="PASS" if run("outer_loopback_isolation",prefix+["python","-c",code]) else "FAIL"
 out["network_test_scope"]="Outer-container loopback positive control versus inner sandbox; no external endpoint or model API request."
try:
 main()
except Exception as e:
 out["probe_exception"]=repr(e)
print(json.dumps(out),flush=True)
